name: The Sims 5
summary:
Project Rene started as an attempt at a "next generation Sims game," speculated in the Sims community to be The Sims 5. Project Rene was officially unveiled during Electronic Arts's "Behind The Sims" summit on October 18, 2022. The project eventually shifted to a mobile-only multiplayer spin-off game and EA confirmed The Sims 5 was not being developed.

Development was ‘paused’ on October 21, 2026 to prioritize efforts on “Project Evergreen” which is expected to be a successor to The Sims 4.
